chunks: These are the verses of the perspicuous Book.

key_terms.الْكِتَابِ: The Book, referring to the Quran
key_terms.الْمُبِينِ: The Clear, the Manifest, the one that makes things evident

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Kitab Al-Mubin' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the Quran's self-authenticating clarity, countering the polytheists' claim that it was merely 'poetry' or 'magic' by affirming its divine origin as a manifest book. It serves as a rhetorical prelude to Surah Ash-Shu'ara, where the Quran's coherence is contrasted with the fragmented, superstitious verses of the poets, reinforcing the concept of 'Bayyinah' (clear proof) central to Imami theology.
